children: Brant Standridge president, a move that is said to set him up for a CEO successor role.
He has served as president of consumer and business banking since joining Huntington in April 2022.
In the expanded role, Standridge is set to oversee the company's revenue-generating businesses and report to CEO Steve Steinour.
Steinour plans to continue as chairman and CEO for several more years, focusing on company strategy and execution.
Steinour, 68, and the bank's board had started searching for potential CEO candidates about two years ago, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday.
Huntington is likely to promote another person to lead the consumer and regional banking unit in 2027, the report noted.

title: Huntington appoints Brant Standridge president; move reportedly sets him up for CEO successor role
